findings: TERM/KILL stage timeouts suppress the mandatory final direct timeout because the producer tests only timeout kind and PID.
COMPLETE does not require the real owner direct wait timestamp to be no later than the original 220-second owner deadline.
Wrong-parent later identity pairs can establish direct wait birth and direct timeout birth is not joined to established authority.
Direct signal errors can follow the direct wait and adopted signal errors do not require immediate identity-pair authority or later retirement.
Owner cleanup adopted raw waits are not passed through the terminal wait-status decoder.
